newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street shares seen opening higher.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street shares seen opening higher.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open still higher Tuesday, brushing against the 7,500 level it briefly passed on Monday.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed unofficially on Monday up 43 points at 7,479. The 30-year bond was up 5/32 at a 6.81 percent yield and the Standard & Poor's futures index was up 1.00 at 866.85.

"We've had, what, 10 records in 12 sessions. Bonds are up again and my sense is stocks will continue to show some rotation," with the focus on second-tier or small-cap issues, said Alan Ackerman, a market strategist at Fahnestock & Co.
